description.value:
The name of this semi-auto rifle refers to the nine-tailed fox of myth. No, the Kyubi doesn't have nine barrels, but with the way it rains bullets on your enemies, you wouldn't know. Tsunami Defense Systems strives for quality craftsmanship and unparalleled optics in all of its weapons. The Kyubi is no exception. Its factory-issue laser sight offers for precise marksmanship right out of the box. And while some scoff at the plastic casing, Tsunami's engineers stand by the design. They aren't cutting corners to to save money – they're delivering one of the lightest, reliable, and powerful rifles on the market.

Cost: 1,500eb (Very Expensive)

Class: EQ Assault Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Marksman Rifle

Damage: 6d6, Drop Lowest • Capacity: 20 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: NoneConcealable: No

Slots: 2 • Attachments: Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: None

Range: Marksman Rifle
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Damage is 6d6, dropping the lowest die. CPR 0.92.4 can't drop dice automatically, so drop them by hand from the damage roll.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
